query:
update assignments
        set
            status = $2,
            deadline_at = $3,
            published_at = $4,
            max_score = $5,
            late_period_days = $6,
            late_penalty_per_period = $7,
            late_max_periods = $8,
            late_deducted_from = $9,
            makeup_offered = $10,
            makeup_credit = $11,
            revision = revision + 1
        where id = $1
          and revision = $12
